# Distillery Map

> A free, open distillery map — 6,131 distilleries, tasting rooms, and spirit
> producers worldwide, community-built and growing. distillerymap.org

## What this site is

Distillery Map is the largest free, open map of the world's distilleries.
It covers whiskey, whisky, bourbon, gin, and other spirit producers across
every continent, with names, locations, websites, and visitor information
where available. It is community-built: anyone can submit a new distillery,
report a closure, or suggest a correction, and distillery owners can claim
their listing to keep details accurate.

## Key facts

- 6,131 distilleries, tasting rooms, and spirit producers mapped worldwide
- Data compiled from OpenStreetMap, Wikidata, and community submissions
- Free to use; no account required
- Dataset available as GeoJSON: https://distillerymap.org/data/distilleries.geojson
- Embeddable map for partners: https://distillerymap.org/embed

## Key pages

- Home / interactive map: https://distillerymap.org
- Embed (for websites wanting the map): https://distillerymap.org/embed

## For distillery owners

If your distillery is listed, you can claim the listing from its map popup to
correct your details and add visitor information (tours, tastings, booking
links). New distilleries can be submitted from the map's Contribute button.
